snippet.title: KinForge – Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
KinForge is a co-op, creature-collector action RPG where every fusion of powers creates new experiences, wild combos, and the strength to fight against spreading Corruption. Forge bonds with Ancient Elementals, beings of the Mystic Realm, and restore a world on the brink of collapse.

👉 Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4096150/KinForge

👉 Get updates + join the Kinforge community:
https://kinforge.firstlook.gg/

👉 Visit the official website:
https://playkinforge.com
